newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia NSW grains board see barley premium.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia NSW grains board see barley premium.

text.p: The New South Wales Grains Board said on Sunday its initial estimates of pool returns indicate a A$25 a tonne premium over other bidders for 1996/97 feed barley returns will be achieved.
"NSW Grains board current pool estimates for feed barley compare favourably with other bidders' trading divisions, with delivered port prices around A$25.00 less than ours," it said.
In malting barley, a forecast net pool return rate of A$225.00 a tonne equated to an average silo return of around A$180.00 a tonne, but would vary on individual silo freight rates, the board said.
The number two malt barley pool forecast is A$195.00 a tonne, with an average silo return of A$150.00 a tonne, it said.
Feed barley is quoted at A$175.00 a tonne, with an average silo return of around A$130.00 a tonne, it said.
The forecast for canola is A$418.000 a tonne, with an average silo return of about A$375.00 a tonne, the board said.
It is too early in the season to predict the size of the this year's barley crop, although excellent growing conditions suggest a large harvest for both malting and feed barley, the board said.
